# Your Bhoomi

> Your Bhoomi is an NRI property desk in Hyderabad, India. We are the trusted local partner for families living abroad who need someone to watch, manage, transfer, and keep ancestral land compliant — then report back on WhatsApp in plain language.

Your Bhoomi is not a listing portal. A named, Aadhaar-verified local person stands in for the owner on the plot, at the Tahsildar / MRO office, and at the Sub-Registrar.

## Who it is for

- Non-Resident Indians in the US, UK, Gulf, Singapore, Australia, and Canada
- City families in India who left village land unattended
- Siblings splitting or gifting ancestral property across generations

## What we do

- Watch: scheduled boundary visits, dated photos, same-day encroachment alerts
- Manage: repairs, caretakers, tenants, seasonal farm work with quotes you approve remotely
- Transfer: ancestral gift, partition, sale, and succession until mutation matches the family
- Comply: mutation, Pahani / Patta, property tax, survey maps, encumbrance certificates

## Where we operate

Live belts: Hyderabad region (Nalgonda, Siddipet, Warangal), coastal Andhra (Guntur–Vijayawada), Coimbatore & Nilgiris, Mysuru. Desk in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad.
